headline: Japan’s economy unexpectedly shrinks in July-September as consumption falters
summary: Japan's economy unexpectedly shrank in the July-September period as consumption weakened. Households remain vulnerable to persistent inflation despite rising wages.
why: Japan is the world's fourth-largest economy, and its growth data shapes Bank of Japan policy expectations, yen trading and Nikkei 225 sentiment.
why_moved: A contraction against expectations of growth can shift views on Japan's interest-rate path and weigh on equities. Persistent inflation squeezing household spending adds to the downside pressure.
